ideology.coaldust.trait.bloodeating.desc: The Blood Lancet draws blood from mobs. Common blood: Regeneration, Night Vision, food. Strong mobs give rare blood (beast, ender, witch), bosses give dragon, wither, warden and elder guardian blood with powerful effects. 20 min without blood: Thirst.
ideology.coaldust.trait.nudism.desc: No armor: Speed, Haste, Jump Boost. Any armor: Weakness, Slowness, Mining Fatigue.
ideology.coaldust.trait.flagellantism.de: Taking damage grants Resistance, Regeneration II on low health. Scourge (once a minute): Resistance and Haste. 20 min without pain: Pride (Weakness).
ideology.coaldust.trait.collectivism.des: More members, more power: 2+ Luck, 3+ Haste, 4+ Resistance, 6+ Health Boost; +10% XP per member. Far from comrades: Slowness.
ideology.coaldust.trait.individualism.de: Fewer members is better. Alone: Resistance, Speed, Haste, XP x1.5. Two: Speed. 4+: Weakness.
ideology.coaldust.trait.nature.desc: Planting grants Regeneration, every 20 plants Haste and Luck. Cutting trees, leaves and flowers: Wrath of Nature (Mining Fatigue, Weakness).
ideology.coaldust.trait.husbandry.desc: Breeding: Regeneration and Luck. 3+ animals nearby: Luck. Killing an animal: Weakness and Hunger.
ideology.coaldust.trait.pacifism.desc: Dealing damage: Weakness and Slowness. 10 min without violence: Peace (Hero of the Village, Resistance).
ideology.coaldust.trait.piracy.desc: Killing mobs and players and looting structure chests grants Speed, Luck, Haste. In water or a boat: Dolphin's Grace. 30 min without plunder: Longing (Slowness).
ideology.coaldust.trait.ritualism.desc: Rituals at the Ritual Altar give strong effects to nearby members. 30 min without a ritual: Oblivion (Bad Luck).
ideology.coaldust.trait.underground.desc: Underground: Haste, Night Vision, below y=0 Resistance. On the surface by day: Weakness and Slowness.
ideology.coaldust.structure.church.desc: Hierarchy and preaching: +25% ideology XP from all quests.
ideology.coaldust.structure.doctrine.des: Strict canon: each level needs 20% less XP.
ideology.coaldust.structure.cult.desc: Everything revolves around the leader: members near them get Luck and periodic Regeneration.
ideology.coaldust.structure.animism.desc: Unity with spirits: empowered trait buffs from level 8 instead of 10.

ideology.coaldust.screen.hint: The main trait defines quests. 15 levels; trait buffs, rituals and blood work from level 5, empowered from 10 (Animism from 8). Debuffs apply immediately. Levels 2 and 3 give the leader a new trait.

ideology.coaldust.ritual.night: 4 Ender Pearls: Ritual of Night, Night Vision 10 min
ideology.coaldust.ritual.strength: Gold Block: Ritual of Fortitude, Resistance and Absorption II
ideology.coaldust.ritual.harvest: 4 Hay Bales: Ritual of Harvest, nearby crops grow, Saturation
ideology.coaldust.ritual.prosperity: Emerald Block: Ritual of Prosperity, Hero of the Village II and Luck II
ideology.coaldust.ritual.cleansing: 3 Golden Apples: Ritual of Cleansing, diseases recede one stage
ideology.coaldust.ritual.harvest.done: The earth gives thanks with a rich harvest.

ideology.coaldust.trait.alchemy.desc: Drinking a potion also grants Absorption; Luck while a potion is active. Milk washes potions away: nausea and weakness. Quests: brewing, drinking potions, hunting witches.
ideology.coaldust.trait.pyrolatry.desc: Near fire, lava, campfires or magma: Fire Resistance and Regeneration. In the Nether: Haste. In rain or water: Weakness and Slowness. Killing a burning enemy grants Fire Resistance.
ideology.coaldust.trait.asceticism.desc: Hunger is strength: at 10 food or less, Speed, Haste, Resistance. Full food: Slowness. Luxury food (golden apples, cake, pies, honey): nausea and hunger.
ideology.coaldust.trait.hunting.desc: Bow or crossbow in hand: Speed. Arrow kill: Speed and Luck. Finishing prey in melee is unworthy: Slowness. Quests: arrow kills, long shots, hunting animals.
ideology.coaldust.trait.enlightenment.de: XP orbs give +25% (+50% at high ideology level). At XP level 30+: Luck and Haste; below level 5: Ignorance (Mining Fatigue). Quests: levels, XP orbs, bookshelves.
ideology.coaldust.ritual.wind: 2 Rabbit Feet: Ritual of Wind, Speed II and Jump Boost II 5 min
ideology.coaldust.ritual.shadow: 4 Phantom Membranes: Ritual of Shadow, Invisibility 3 min and Slow Falling
ideology.coaldust.ritual.life: 4 Glistering Melon Slices: Ritual of Life, Regeneration II and +2 hearts 5 min
ideology.coaldust.ritual.depths: 2 Nautilus Shells: Ritual of Depths, Water Breathing, Conduit Power, Dolphin's Grace 10 min
ideology.coaldust.ritual.crystal: 8 Amethyst Shards: Ritual of Crystals, Haste II and Luck 5 min
ideology.coaldust.ritual.guardians: 3 Iron Blocks: Summon Guardians, 2 iron golems and 3 wolves for 5 minutes
ideology.coaldust.ritual.meteor: 8 Obsidian: Summon Meteor, a small or medium meteor nearby (altar cooldown 30 min)

ideology.coaldust.trait.evolving.desc: Abyss trait. Killing mobs and ideology quests give abyss points. Press G for the skill pillars: Growth (an aura that speeds up plants, furnaces, brewing stands and animals around you), Endurance (protection and regeneration), Might (strength, speed, mining, luck, loot multiplier).
ideology.coaldust.trait.summoner.desc: Abyss trait. V summons an undead squad (base: 1 zombie for 1 min, 20 min cooldown). An army follows you (1 zombie at first); the fallen return after 5 min. Workers (1 at first) — key B: chop wood, mine ore, dig, build, farm and carry loot to chests. Skills are in the G window.

ideology.coaldust.work.btn.dig.tip: Excavate the area layer by layer from the top (chests and furnaces are kept)
ideology.coaldust.work.btn.fill.tip: Choose blocks and a mixing mode, fill empty space in the area (workers take blocks from storage)

ideology.coaldust.fill.mode.checker.tip: Checkerboard: blocks alternate in every direction
